blocks.translation:
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give it to children under the target age under any circumstances.
• There are small parts, so be careful that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking and other danger.
• Do not use it near the ear. If used accidentally, there is a risk of damaging hearing.
• This product uses electronic components, so people using a pacemaker should be cautious.
• Do not play roughly such as by hitting or swinging it around.
• Do not put fingers or the like into moving parts. There is a risk of injury from being pinched.
• Incorrect use of batteries may cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Please observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries) under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Set the +/− (plus/minus) polarity correctly.
• Be sure to turn off the switch and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery leakage fluid gets into the eyes, wash immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow the instructions of your municipal waste disposal authority.

blocks.translation:
• Usage Precautions
• This product is made up of precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, dirty it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold. Dispose of plastic packing materials immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin (plastic) sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts strongly in an unnatural direction.
• Some pronunciations may have different intonation or may be difficult to hear due to the characteristics of the product; please understand. Two units cannot be used simultaneously. If a malfunction occurs, turn the power off and on again.
• Do not affix stickers or similar items to the receiver or transmitter areas. They will stop functioning. The product will not operate if there is an obstacle between the receiver and transmitter.
• This product is manufactured precisely. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• When returning the product to the packaging for storage, always place it in a bag.
• Due to the nature of the product, appearance may vary. Please note this in advance.
